label: Cycles image/texture allocation
qualification: Native Cycles image allocation report; not total dedicated GPU VRAM.

label: Cycles reported peak allocation
qualification: Native Cycles allocation report; can include mapped host memory and excludes driver/compositor overhead.

label: Sampled global GPU peak, mean of two runs
qualification: nvidia-smi sampled global total, including Windows/apps; not isolated per-process VRAM. Desktop usage varied between runs.

label: Evaluated mesh triangles
qualification: Meshes only. Native curves/text are excluded. Source geometry remains intact; modifiers are reversible.

label: Cycles geometry memory report
qualification: Native Cycles geometry statistics, not total scene/driver memory.

label: Render call, mean of two fresh-process runs
qualification: Includes synchronization, rendering, denoising, identical optical-glow compositor and PNG output. Excludes optimization; only two runs, small timing difference.

label: Sampled process RSS peak, mean of two runs
qualification: Freshly opened before/after scenes; does not include the separate optimization-process peak.

label: Packed Blender file size
qualification: Negative reduction means growth. After retains originals for Restore; do not claim smaller files.
